data.summary: Software Engineer focused on backend systems and AI-assisted development, with 2+ years of experience building Java and Spring Boot applications in Cambodian and Korean enterprise environments. Currently maintaining and developing enterprise financial applications at Bizplay (Webcash Group) with Java, MyBatis, and Oracle SQL. Experienced in REST APIs, Spring Security, PostgreSQL, and SQL-driven business logic for financial and B2B platforms. I use AI coding assistants such as Claude Code and Codex for requirement analysis, codebase exploration, debugging, SQL analysis, test preparation, and review, and I remain responsible for verifying every change. I am learning Agent Harness, MCP, and evaluation concepts through structured practice; these are growth areas, not production experience.
